description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git grep' with sparse checkout configurations in a Git repository. It sets up a repository with various sparsity patterns and submodules, and contains multiple test cases verifying that 'git grep' behaves correctly under sparse checkout conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies expectations.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is missing in the working directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific path is a file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
